edge_cases: Salary-range acknowledgement is phrased as a YES/NO gate; answering NO likely ends consideration.
A compound YES/NO question bundles two facts (work authorization without sponsorship AND remote comfort).
Short URL apply.workable.com/j/<ID> and org URL both resolve to the same form; document identity should use the job ID.
